Full story page

The full article body explains how the vendor launched a new registry for machine learning models and agents, aimed at enterprises that need governance over the artifacts their teams consume and publish every day.

It supports versioning, promotion between environments, access control, and vulnerability scanning for the binaries and containers that wrap each model, and integrates with existing continuous integration pipelines and developer tooling.

Pricing and availability were not disclosed, but the vendor said general availability is planned for the first quarter, with design partners already running the product in production across several large financial institutions.
